explanation: This fires only at the D1 step in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 to 99), and it is 0 at GO, at D2, and at every step of earlier trials. In those late trials D1 is high (7-10, usually 10 by trial 98-99) when the previous trial was unrewarded, or when it was rewarded after a rare transition; it stays 0 after a reward that followed a common transition, and often drops back to 0 on the second or third unrewarded D1 in a row.
